note: What the collegiate collector reads (collegiate/run.js). collegiate-rosters.yml (weekly, --skip-backfill): the registry when over 30 days old; every weekly sport's current season and the one before at every school of the division; each schedules sport's current and previous season; the ledger. collegiate-backfill.yml (daily, --only-backfill): past seasons the backfill names, read once (done when collegiate/data/backfill.json records it complete), and a per-host slice of the box scores the held schedules link, until none are left. lanes: how many schools are read at once (each one no faster than its robots.txt asks). Changing this file runs the weekly collector once it reaches main (never on a branch).
